name: read-guard
description: Stops paying twice for file contents: unchanged re-reads become a one-line stub, re-reads after a change become a diff, and stale native 'unchanged' stubs are corrected. Built-in stats show what it saved.

python_cmd.title: Python command (optional)
python_cmd.description: Command that runs Python 3.8+, e.g. python, py -3, or a full path. Leave empty to auto-detect.
